note: Every listed enchant has no level requirement, so a level-19 can carry it.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Fiery Weapon
enchants.notes: The iconic melee weapon proc and a staple of most 19 melee sets.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Crusader
enchants.effect: Chance on hit: +100 Strength for 15s and a small heal.
enchants.notes: Big burst window on proc; healers also run it on a caster weapon for the heal.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Icy Chill
enchants.effect: Chance on hit: frost damage and a movement/attack-speed slow.
enchants.notes: Control option for melee; the slow pressures kiters and flag carriers. Triggers on a flat per-hit chance (not PPM-normalized like Fiery/Crusader/Lifestealing), so it favors a fast weapon.

enchants.name: Enchant Boots - Minor Speed
enchants.notes: Movement speed is highly valued in WSG, especially for flag carriers; a near-universal boots pick.

enchants.name: Lesser Arcanum of Constitution
enchants.notes: Dire Maul libram; the defensive head/leg pick for survivability.

enchants.name: Lesser Arcanum of Voracity
enchants.notes: Dire Maul libram; the agility pick for rogue/hunter/feral damage. Warrior, paladin, and shaman melee builds instead run the parallel +8 Strength arcanum in this slot, since Strength scales their attack power.

enchants.name: Might of the Scourge
enchants.effect: +26 Attack Power and +1% critical strike chance.
enchants.notes: The melee/physical shoulder pick and the centerpiece of most 19 melee sets. Dropped by Sapphiron in Naxxramas (item 23548); the inscription does not soulbind the shoulder, so a level-60 applies it to a BoE Requires Level 19 white shoulder and mails the piece to the twink.

enchants.name: Enchant Cloak - Greater Resistance
enchants.notes: A balanced defensive back pick.

enchants.name: Enchant Cloak - Greater Nature Resistance
enchants.notes: Situational against nature-heavy matchups (shaman, druid, hunter).

enchants.name: Enchant Chest - Major Health
enchants.notes: The survivability chest pick.

enchants.name: Enchant Chest - Greater Stats
enchants.notes: The balanced/offensive chest pick.

enchants.name: Enchant Bracer - Superior Stamina
enchants.notes: The survivability bracer pick.

enchants.name: Enchant Bracer - Superior Strength
enchants.notes: The melee-damage bracer pick.

enchants.name: Enchant Gloves - Superior Agility
enchants.notes: The top gloves pick for physical-damage classes.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Lifestealing
enchants.effect: Chance on hit: deal Shadow damage and heal the attacker for the amount dealt.
enchants.notes: Self-healing sustain; favored on midfield/duelist builds.

enchants.name: Accurate Scope
enchants.effect: +3 weapon damage (applies to a bow, crossbow, or gun).
enchants.notes: Engineering-crafted; flat ranged-weapon damage.

enchants.name: Fortitude of the Scourge
enchants.notes: The survivability counterpart to Might of the Scourge. Dropped by Sapphiron in Naxxramas (item 23549); does not soulbind the shoulder, so it's applied to a BoE Requires Level 19 white shoulder and mailed to the twink.

enchants.name: Enchant Cloak - Lesser Shadow Resistance
enchants.notes: Situational against warlocks and shadow priests — the bracket's main Shadow-damage dealers.

enchants.name: Enchant Cloak - Lesser Agility
enchants.notes: The offensive back pick for agility-scaling DPS sets — rogue, hunter, feral, enhance.

enchants.name: Enchant Cloak - Superior Defense
enchants.notes: Flat physical mitigation; the pick into melee- and physical-cleave-heavy comps.

enchants.name: Enchant Cloak - Dodge
enchants.notes: Avoidance for tank and flag-carrier sets into melee-heavy comps.

enchants.name: Enchant Gloves - Greater Strength
enchants.notes: Alternative to Superior Agility on strength-scaling classes.

enchants.name: Enchant Shield - Greater Stamina
enchants.notes: The survivability shield pick.

enchants.name: Enchant Shield - Frost Resistance
enchants.notes: Situational against mages and frost effects.

enchants.name: Thorium Shield Spike
enchants.effect: Chance on block to deal Physical damage to the attacker.
enchants.notes: Blacksmithing-crafted; retaliation damage on block.

enchants.name: Steel Weapon Chain
enchants.notes: Blacksmithing-crafted; prevents disarm on a melee weapon.

enchants.name: Enchant 2H Weapon - Agility
enchants.notes: The agility stat-stick for 2H weapons.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Agility
enchants.notes: The agility stat-stick for one-hand weapons.

enchants.name: Enchant Bracer - Greater Intellect
enchants.notes: A larger mana pool on hybrid/caster-leaning builds.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Mighty Intellect
enchants.notes: Caster intellect stat-stick, usually on a staff.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Mighty Spirit
enchants.notes: Regen-focused spirit stat-stick, usually on a staff.

enchants.name: Lesser Arcanum of Rumination
enchants.notes: Dire Maul libram; the mana head/leg pick for caster-hybrid damage.

enchants.name: Arcanum of Focus
enchants.effect: +8 Spell Damage and Healing (applies to head or legs).
enchants.notes: Dire Maul libram; the spellpower head/leg pick for glass-cannon fire/frost mages and damage warlocks. A level-50+ applies it, then hands the piece over through the trade window's will-not-be-traded slot so a 19 can equip it.

enchants.name: Resilience of the Scourge
enchants.notes: The restoration counterpart to Might/Fortitude of the Scourge. Dropped by Sapphiron in Naxxramas (item 23547); does not soulbind the shoulder, so it's applied to a BoE Requires Level 19 white shoulder and mailed to the twink.

enchants.name: Enchant Gloves - Healing Power
enchants.notes: The gloves pick for restoration/support hybrids.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Healing Power
enchants.notes: Restoration stat-stick on a one-hand caster weapon.

enchants.name: Enchant Shield - Superior Spirit
enchants.notes: The regen-leaning shield pick for caster hybrids.

enchants.name: Power of the Scourge
enchants.effect: +15 Spell Damage and Healing and +1% spell critical strike.
enchants.notes: The spellpower counterpart to Might/Fortitude of the Scourge. Dropped by Sapphiron in Naxxramas (item 23545); does not soulbind the shoulder, so it's applied to a BoE Requires Level 19 white shoulder and mailed to the twink.

enchants.name: Enchant Gloves - Frost Power
enchants.notes: The gloves pick for frost-spec casters.

enchants.name: Enchant Weapon - Spell Power
enchants.notes: Spellpower stat-stick on a one-hand caster weapon.

enchants.name: Enchant Chest - Major Mana
enchants.notes: The caster-DPS counterpart to Major Health.

enchants.name: Enchant Bracer - Healing Power
enchants.notes: The bracer pick for restoration/support hybrids.

enchants.name: Enchant Gloves - Shadow Power
enchants.notes: The gloves pick for shadow-spec casters.
